title: A deposit is taken on the account of the current Bill To
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Approved, billed to customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Click Add Deposit.
  4. Pick a Payment Method.
  5. Enter 50.00 as the Deposit Amount.
  6. Click Submit Deposit.
  7. Open customer B's Deposits tab.
  8. Open customer A's Deposits tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Finance tab shows Add Deposit.

Step 3:

  • The Create Deposit window opens.

Step 4:

  • The Payment Method is picked.

Step 5:

  • Deposit Amount shows 50.00.

Step 6:

  • The deposit is recorded.

Step 7:

  • The $50.00 deposit for work order 1 is listed.

Step 8:

  • The $50.00 deposit is not listed on customer A's tab.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12312 (Story 10, Receivables follow the Bill To)

  • S10-R2: “A deposit is taken on the account of whoever is the Bill To when it is recorded.”
  • Feature Overview, State by action (Action | Open | Invoiced | Internal or No Charge): “Take a deposit | Allowed; lands on the Bill To's account | As today | n/a”
  • Feature Overview, Core Bill To: “The Bill To owns the receivable: payment terms and due date, credit limit, Credit Hold, Customer PO and "PO is required", deposits, payments, credits, the QuickBooks invoice customer, IBS, the portal Pay button and the invoice email.”
